# Invoke-ZbxTemplateGroupPropagation

## SYNOPSIS

Applies a template group's permissions to its subgroups.

## SYNTAX

```
Invoke-ZbxTemplateGroupPropagation [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplateGroup>[]> [-Permissions] [-Force] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Invoke-ZbxTemplateGroupPropagation cmdlet copies the user group permissions of the template groups given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped groups) to their subgroups, with templategroup.propagate; a subgroup is a group whose name starts with the group's name and a slash, such as Templates/Web/Shop. -Permissions is required by the server. The command writes nothing, and -WhatIf shows what it would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Give a template group's subgroups its permissions

```powershell
Invoke-ZbxTemplateGroupPropagation -InputObject 'Templates/Web' -Permissions
```

Every user group with a permission on Templates/Web gets the same permission on Templates/Web/...

### Example 2: Preview propagating every template group's permissions

```powershell
Get-ZbxTemplateGroup | Invoke-ZbxTemplateGroupPropagation -Permissions -WhatIf
```

-WhatIf names each group the command would propagate, and changes nothing.
